### 1 — Scene
A light vegetable meal: corn rounds, green beans, zucchini, leafy greens, cherry tomatoes, and white pieces that appear to be tofu (possibly a soft cheese).

### 2 — Vessel
A square dinner plate, approximately 25 cm across. Using a **26 cm equivalent circular diameter**, its area is approximately **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Two corn-on-the-cob rounds, tofu-like white pieces, green beans, zucchini, spinach or similar leaves, cherry tomatoes, a few seeds, and a light oily sheen. No substantial sauce is visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas are allocated between items without counting overlapping layers twice.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Corn rounds | 12% | 64 × 3 = 192 ml | 0.7 | 134 | 96 | 129 |
| Tofu-like pieces | 9% | 48 × 1.7 = 82 ml | 0.95 | 78 | 100 | 78 |
| Green beans | 9% | 48 × 1.2 = 58 ml | 0.6 | 35 | 35 | 12 |
| Zucchini | 7% | 37 × 1.3 = 48 ml | 0.65 | 31 | 20 | 6 |
| Leafy greens | 9% | 48 × 2 = 96 ml | 0.15 | 14 | 23 | 3 |
| Cherry tomatoes | 4% | 21 × 2 = 42 ml | 0.6 | 25 | 18 | 5 |
| Scattered seeds | 0.5% | 2.7 × 1 = 2.7 ml | 0.7 | 2 | 580 | 12 |
| Oil sheen | Overlay | Approximately 3 ml | 0.92 | 3 | 884 | 27 |

Food occupies approximately **50.5% of the plate**. Oil is an overlay rather than additional covered area.

### 8 — Sanity check
The calculation gives approximately **322 g and 272 kcal**. This is plausible for a modest, vegetable-heavy plate. Corn-cob weight makes the edible weight and energy less certain; the corn estimate is approximate. If the white pieces are feta rather than tofu, the meal could contain roughly **130 kcal more**.
